title: Late-Refund Interest Rate Schedule for Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Credit Balances
content:
A credit balance left on an ended Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan is refunded as the credit balance plus late-refund interest when the refund is made after the 21-day refund period. The late-refund interest is the credit balance multiplied by the late-refund rate and by the refund's late days, divided by 365.

## Late-refund rate

| Calendar days from the date the plan ended to the handling date | Late-refund rate (a year) |
| --- | --- |
| 61 or more | 0.12 |
| 31 to 60 | 0.06 |
| 30 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundary reading

- A plan that ended 61 days before the handling date takes 0.12; one that ended 60 days before takes 0.06.
- A plan that ended 31 days before takes 0.06; one that ended 30 days before takes no late-refund rate.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A credit balance of 73.00, a plan that ended 61 days before the handling date and 40 late days give late-refund interest of 73.00 multiplied by 0.12 and by 40, divided by 365 — about 0.96 before the refund is rounded to the cent.
